meta.notes: d_x in %; d_h1000_m in m; s10 = day/sfcWind; m1000 = cell-days with 1000 hPa >= HMIN above ground

event_scaling.note: crude: CF elasticity from a regression through the origin of the 22-region mean CF change on the sfcWind change across models; shift in per K = 2.07 x elasticity x d(s10/V_hub) / dT, i.e. the mean CF change at hub height is taken as elasticity x (d sfcWind - d(s10/V_hub)), and the section 14 slope -2.07 converts it to events per K
